result.title: QFacePlacement: From Arbitrary Tensorization to Semantic Spatial Correspondence in Modern Face Verification
result.comment: Accepted at 11th International Conference on Computer Vision & Image Processing (CVIP)
result.summary: Quantum-inspired computer vision often reshapes high-dimensional features into tensors and applies tensor-network models. In face verification, this can be misleading: modern embeddings are optimized for cosine similarity, and tensorization alone does not establish the low-rank structure needed for tensor trains or matrix-product operators (MPOs). We study model placement through two controlled interfaces. First, cross-model embedding alignment requires a 512 x 512 operator to map AdaFace embeddings into ArcFace space. Dense Ridge and Procrustes mappings remain strong, while deterministic TT-SVD and MPO compression underperform even with basis changes and low-rank residuals. At a 64K-parameter storage budget, mean directional AUC is 0.9297 for dense Ridge, 0.8952 for rank-64 SVD, 0.8685 for the best low-rank-MPO hybrid, and approximately 0.649 for raw MPO. Second, before global pooling, we construct a 7 x 7 x 7 x 7 probe-gallery correspondence tensor from local AdaFace descriptors. A geometry-aware symmetric tensor train with bond dimension 2 uses 122 trainable parameters, compared with 2,403 for a dense linear matcher, while attaining an LFW AUC of 0.9802. Yet compression does not translate into better low-false-acceptance performance: on CFP-FP, TAR at FAR = 0.001 is 0.0102 versus 0.1734 for global cosine matching, and on CPLFW it is 0.7805 versus 0.8737. These results suggest that quantum-inspired factorization is most credible when the chosen interface provides task-aligned axes and compressible structure. They also show why aggregate AUC must be assessed alongside operational low-FAR metrics.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在人脸验证中检验「量子启发的张量化」是否真的适用：分别考察跨模型嵌入对齐（稠密算子与 TT-SVD/MPO 压缩对比）和池化前的局部描述子对应张量，发现低秩张量方法参数更少但低 FAR 指标明显落后。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对视觉嵌入做低秩张量压缩的诊断与「压缩不转化为操作性指标收益」的负结果，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节在内部状态压缩后是否保留，以及聚合指标与低误接受率等操作指标并用的评价思路。
